title: Verdict Core public claims ledger
public_evidence_rule: A public claim may use verified or observed wording only when its listed evidence supports that wording, its limitations are preserved, and its per-entry review deadline has not expired; all entry reviews had expired by 2026-10-08 and must be refreshed after review.

entries.claim: Verdict filters candidates through hard eligibility gates before advisory ranking.
entries.allowed_wording: Verdict filters candidates through hard eligibility gates before advisory ranking.
entries.metric_definition: Ordering and exclusion invariants are defined by the named tests; no provider metric is asserted.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source and test paths.
entries.likely_objection: Does advisory ranking bypass the hard gate?
entries.falsification_test: Attempt to reintroduce an excluded candidate through the ranker and assert the selected set remains gate-bounded.
entries.missing_evidence: None for the local invariant; live gateway behavior is outside scope.
entries.downgrade_wording: The local tests cover the eligibility/ranking invariant.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: Local availability parsing treats malformed and contradictory runtime observations explicitly; protected admission has a stale-cache exception.
entries.allowed_wording: Malformed and contradictory observations have explicit local handling. Cached reports may be served stale during the configured grace window, and protected admission does not independently recheck age.
entries.metric_definition: Source and fixture behavior, not a guarantee that stale cached READY reports cannot authorize protected work.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source and test paths.
entries.likely_objection: Could a catalog row be treated as health?
entries.falsification_test: Serve a stale eligible/READY report within the cache grace window and check whether EligibilityGate.evaluate rejects it before protected work.
entries.missing_evidence: A protected-admission age check and regression are needed before restoring the universal fail-closed guarantee.
entries.downgrade_wording: The local adapter covers malformed and contradictory observations; cache freshness is a separate boundary.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: Runtime passports require fresh direct negotiation before hard capability admission.
entries.allowed_wording: Runtime passport resolution requires fresh direct negotiation for hard capability admission.
entries.metric_definition: Admission is the boolean result of RuntimeCapabilityPassport.resolve/satisfies under the versioned contract.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source, tests, and schema paths.
entries.likely_objection: Does a declaration or catalog entry authorize a capability?
entries.falsification_test: Provide only declared, inferred, claimed, expired, or unsupported evidence and assert admission remains false.
entries.missing_evidence: Protocol-specific handshakes and probes are separate adapters.
entries.downgrade_wording: The passport contract prevents the tested non-direct evidence from authorizing admission.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: Verdict can produce a deterministic compatibility report from runtime passport evidence.
entries.allowed_wording: Verdict can render a deterministic, fail-closed compatibility matrix from existing runtime passport evidence.
entries.metric_definition: Equivalent passport inputs, requirements, and timestamp produce the same canonical report and digest.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source and test paths.
entries.likely_objection: Does rendering the matrix prove a service is live?
entries.falsification_test: Compare reports with reordered mappings and with secret-bearing identity values; assert stable ordering and safe output.
entries.missing_evidence: No live runtime discovery or protocol execution is included in this claim.
entries.downgrade_wording: The matrix is a deterministic report over already-issued evidence.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: The flagship demo is credential-free and reproducible.
entries.allowed_wording: The repository includes a credential-free deterministic quickstart fixture with explicit exclusions.
entries.metric_definition: Two local subprocess runs produce identical output, and provider credential environment variables do not alter it.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source and test paths.
entries.likely_objection: Is the demo a live deployment?
entries.falsification_test: Run the demo in an empty temporary directory with provider variables set and compare output.
entries.missing_evidence: Live provider execution, adoption, and production readiness are not demonstrated.
entries.downgrade_wording: The fixture demonstrates the local contract without network access or credentials.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: Local benchmark fixture structure and digests are repeatable; evidence bundles match when collected artifact bytes match.
entries.allowed_wording: Local fixture structure and digests can be checked; benchmark timings and threshold verdicts are observed. Bundles are byte-identical for identical collected artifact bytes.
entries.metric_definition: Stable fixture structure and digests are separate from measured timestamps/timings; archive bytes are stable only when collected artifact bytes are identical.
entries.redacted_substitute: No redaction required; references are public source, fixture, and test paths.
entries.likely_objection: Does a fixture benchmark prove provider quality?
entries.falsification_test: Run the reproducibility tests twice and inspect that live-provider mode requires explicit opt-in.
entries.missing_evidence: No live-provider quality or latency result is authorized; elapsed timings are not byte-deterministic.
entries.downgrade_wording: The checked-in fixture harness is reproducible; it is not a live benchmark.
entries.review_status: expired_as_of_2026-10-08; evidence and wording need renewed exact-source review before use

entries.claim: The recorded OmniRoute catalog snapshots prove that thousands of listed routes are runnable.
entries.allowed_wording: A historical catalog snapshot recorded thousands of advertised rows, with bounded liveness evidence and explicit limitations.
entries.metric_definition: Rows and unique IDs are snapshot counts; they are not availability, authorization, quota, or eligibility measures.
entries.authorship: observed repository artifact; raw payloads excluded
entries.redacted_substitute: Sanitized aggregate snapshots; raw catalog payloads, credentials, authorization headers, and response bodies are excluded.
entries.likely_objection: Does a catalog row imply successful execution?
entries.falsification_test: Require fresh direct observations for a sample and verify that catalog membership alone cannot satisfy protected eligibility.
entries.missing_evidence: Current liveness, authorization, quota, and route-level execution evidence.
entries.downgrade_wording: The repository records a bounded historical catalog observation; it does not claim all rows are runnable.

lifecycle.selection_rule: Select fresh active or verified claims by default (observed only with include_observed opt-in). Group by subject; choose verified before active, then verified_at or observed_at fallback, observed_at, confidence, and claim-id. Superseded history remains queryable.
lifecycle.dispute_rule: Disputed claims are surfaced in hydration omissions and cannot satisfy a required fact.

freshness_policy.expiry_rule: A claim is expired when now is greater than or equal to observed_at plus ttl_seconds.
freshness_policy.clock_skew_rule: Observations up to clock_skew_seconds in the future are accepted; farther-future observations are rejected.
freshness_policy.missing_policy_rule: A missing source-type policy is not fresh and cannot satisfy a required fact.

lifecycle.privacy_rule: Persist claim-id, text-hash, status, timestamps, confidence, and verified source/evidence references; never persist claim text.
lifecycle.audit_rule: When ClaimsLedger is configured with ReceiptStore, each status transition appends linked claim_status_transition evidence. Without ReceiptStore, no durable transition receipt is written.

source_scope: Claims reviewed against the audited source revision; historical execution evidence remains tied to its original run and is not proof of execution at this source revision.
review_status: All 11 entry review_after dates (2026-10-06) had expired by the 2026-10-08 audit. Preserve the original dates; entries need fresh exact-source review before their verified or observed wording is reused. The structural validator currently compares entry dates only with the historical freeze date.
